action.text: if exists (select 1 from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @ma_quyen) begin declare @c1 varchar(33), @c2 varchar(33) select top 1 @c1 = so_ct1, @c2 = so_ct2 from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @ma_quyen select ltrim(rtrim(isnull(@c1, ''))) as c1, ltrim(rtrim(isnull(@c2, ''))) as c2 return end
